evidence.reason: The workflow's denylist scan invokes gitleaks on `git log -p` output at line 102 (and again at line 105). A PR can add a `.gitattributes` rule such as `credentials.txt -diff`, causing Git to emit only a binary-file summary and gitleaks to skip the file contents, so a prohibited value can pass. That violates the contract's requirement that the denylist remain fail-closed and blocking. Adding `--text` to both `--log-opts` values forces Git to treat files as text and is a routine correctness fix.
